arxiv-2101-02109.title: Modelling and Simulating the Noisy Behaviour of Near-term Quantum Computers
arxiv-2101-02109.creator: Konstantinos Georgopoulos, Clive Emary, Paolo Zuliani
arxiv-2101-02109.description: Abstract Noise dominates every aspect of near-term quantum computers, rendering it exceedingly difficult to carry out even small computations. In this paper we are concerned with the modelling of noise in Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) computers. We focus on three error groups that represent the main sources of noise during a computation and present quantum channels that model each source.

arxiv-2105-07739.title: Toward the Design of Fault-Tolerance- and Peak- Power-Aware Multi-Core Mixed-Criticality Systems
arxiv-2105-07739.creator: Behnaz Ranjbar, Ali Hosseinghorban, Mohammad Salehi, Alireza Ejlali, and Akash Kumar
arxiv-2105-07739.description: Abstract Mixed-Criticality (MC) systems have recently been devised to address the requirements of real-time systems in industrial applications, where the system runs tasks with different criticality levels on a single platform. In some workloads, a high-critically task might overrun and overload the system, or a fault can occur during the execution.

arxiv-2108-03622.title: Rigidity of the round cylinders in Ricci shrinkers
arxiv-2108-03622.creator: Yu Li, and, Bing Wang
arxiv-2108-03622.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove that the round cylinders are rigid in the space of Ricci shrinkers. Namely, any Ricci shrinker that is sufficiently close to S n − 1 × ℝ S^{n-1}\times\mathbb{R} in the pointed-Gromov-Hausdorff topology must itself be isometric to S n − 1 × ℝ S^{n-1}\times\mathbb{R} .

This work was sup
arxiv-2111-01873.creator: Mohammad Khajenejad, Zeyuan Jin, Sze Zheng Yong
arxiv-2111-01873.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Khajenejad, Zeyuan Jin, Sze Zheng Yong. This paper considers the problem of designing interval observers for hidden mode switched nonlinear systems with bounded noise signals that are compromised by false data injection and switching attacks.

arxiv-2206-05470.title: Localized absorption of laser energy in X-mode configuration of magnetized plasma
arxiv-2206-05470.creator: Ayushi Vashistha 1,2, Devshree Mandal 1,2, Srimanta Maity 3, Amita Das 3
arxiv-2206-05470.description: Abstract The heating of ions via lower hybrid waves has been observed in several astrophysical as well as laboratory plasmas. We have conducted Particle-In-Cell simulations to demonstrate absorption of the incident laser pulse at a chosen localized point in the target by manipulating the plasma density profile.

arxiv-2302-01563.title: Causal Inference Based Single-branch Ensemble Trees For Uplift Modeling
arxiv-2302-01563.creator: Fanglan Zheng, Menghan Wang, Kun Li, Jiang Tian, Xiaojia Xiang
arxiv-2302-01563.description: Abstract In this manuscript (ms), we propose causal inference based single-branch ensemble trees for uplift modeling, namely CIET. Different from standard classification methods for predictive probability modeling, CIET aims to achieve the change in the predictive probability of outcome caused by an action or a treatment.

arxiv-2311-08393.title: MVSA-Net: Multi-View State-Action Recognition for Robust and Deployable Trajectory Generation
arxiv-2311-08393.creator: Ehsan Asali, Prashant Doshi, Jin Sun
arxiv-2311-08393.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ehsan Asali, Prashant Doshi, Jin Sun. The learn-from-observation (LfO) paradigm is a human-inspired mode for a robot to learn to perform a task simply by watching it being performed. LfO can facilitate robot integration on factory floors by minimizing disruption and reducing tedious programming.

arxiv-2506-17218.title: Machine Mental Imagery: Empower Multimodal Reasoning with Latent Visual Tokens
arxiv-2506-17218.creator: Zeyuan Yang 1 Xueyang Yu 1 Delin Chen 1 Maohao Shen 2 Chuang Gan 1 1 University of Massachusetts, Amherst 2 Massachusetts Institute of Technology Project Page: https://vlm-mirage.github.io Code: https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/Mirage
arxiv-2506-17218.description: Abstract Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at multimodal understanding, yet their text-only decoding forces them to verbalize visual reasoning, limiting performance on tasks that demand visual imagination. Recent attempts train VLMs to render explicit images, but the heavy image-generation pre-training often hinders the reasoning ability.

arxiv-2508-14709.title: Improving Resource-Efficient Speech Enhancement via Neural Differentiable DSP Vocoder Refinement Thanks: † \dagger Work done during an internship at Meta (Reality Labs Research). Corresponding author e-mail: heitor.guimaraes@inrs.ca
arxiv-2508-14709.creator: Heitor R. Guimarães †, Ke Tan, Juan Azcarreta, Jesus Alvarez, Prabhav Agrawal, Ashutosh Pandey, Buye Xu
arxiv-2508-14709.description: Abstract Deploying speech enhancement (SE) systems in wearable devices, such as smart glasses, is challenging due to the limited computational resources on the device. Although deep learning methods have achieved high-quality results, their computational cost limits their feasibility on embedded platforms.

arxiv-2510-11136.title: Quasi-periodic oscillations in gamma-ray bursts’ prompt light curves
arxiv-2510-11136.creator: Mariusz Tarnopolski
arxiv-2510-11136.description: Abstract I report on the discovery of 34 new quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in the prompt light curves of long gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) from the Swift/BAT catalog: with one or more constant leading periods, as well as several chirping signals. This is the largest homogenously identified sample or GRB QPOs to date.

arxiv-2511-12671.title: DensePercept-NCSSD: Vision Mamba towards Real-time Dense Visual Perception with Non-Causal State Space Duality
arxiv-2511-12671.creator: Tushar Anand, Advik Sinha, Abhijit Das
arxiv-2511-12671.description: Abstract In this work, we propose an accurate and real-time optical flow and disparity estimation model by fusing pairwise input images in the proposed non-causal selective state space for dense perception tasks. We propose a non-causal Mamba block-based model that is fast and efficient and aptly manages the constraints present in a real-time applications.

arxiv-2511-13027.title: Scaling Generative Verifiers For Natural Language Mathematical Proof Verification And Selection
arxiv-2511-13027.creator: Sadegh Mahdavi 1,2∗ , Branislav Kisacanin 1,3 , Shubham Toshniwal 1 , Wei Du 1 , Ivan Moshkov 1 , George Armstrong 1 , Renjie Liao 2† , Christos Thrampoulidis 2† , Igor Gitman 1† 1 NVIDIA, 2 University of British Columbia, 3 Institute for AI R&D of Serbia
arxiv-2511-13027.description: Abstract Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable success on final-answer mathematical problems, largely due to the ease of applying reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, the reasoning underlying these solutions is often flawed. Advancing to rigorous proof-based mathematics requires reliable proof verification capabilities.

pmc-10520065.title: Psychological states affecting initial pupil size changes after olfactory stimulation in healthy participants
pmc-10520065.creator: Hiroatsu Hatsukawa, Masaaki Ishikawa
pmc-10520065.description: Odor perception affects physiological and psychological states. Pupillary light reflex (PLR) parameters can be affected by olfactory stimulation and psychological states, although it remains unclear whether the olfactory stimulation-induced psychological changes can associate with PLR parameter changes. This study aimed to investigate effects of olfactory stimulation-induced psychological changes on PLR parameter changes with repeated measurements.

pmc-10673240.title: Postmortem Alteration of Purine Metabolism in Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-10673240.creator: Phakchira Somtua, Churdsak Jaikang, Giatgong Konguthaithip, Kanicnan Intui, Somlada Watcharakhom, Timothy E. O’Brien, Yutti Amornlertwatana
pmc-10673240.description: A new approach for assisting in the diagnosis of coronary artery disease (CAD) as a cause of death is essential in cases where complete autopsy examinations are not feasible. The purine pathway has been associated with CAD patients, but the understanding of this pathway in postmortem changes needs to be explored.

pmc-11615164.title: Potential compensatory mechanisms preserving cardiac function in myotubular myopathy
pmc-11615164.creator: Alix Simon, Nadège Diedhiou, David Reiss, Marie Goret, Erwan Grandgirard, Jocelyn Laporte
pmc-11615164.description: X-Linked myotubular myopathy (XLMTM) is characterized by severe skeletal muscle weakness and reduced life expectancy. The pathomechanism and the impact of non-muscular defects affecting survival, such as liver dysfunction, are poorly understood. Here, we investigated organ-specific effects of XLMTM using the Mtm1−/y mouse model.

pmc-12460248.title: Sudden cardiac death in the young: single-center study of Bari autopsy cases
pmc-12460248.creator: Cecilia Salzillo, Marco Matteo Ciccone, Francesco Introna, Vincenzo Ezio Santobuono, Biagio Solarino, Andrea Marzullo
pmc-12460248.description: IntroductionSudden Cardiac Death (SCD) is one of the main causes of death in the world, with a significant impact especially on young people. Sudden Cardiac Death in the Young (SCDY) is characterized by multifactorial etiology, which includes cardiomyopathies, myocarditis, channelopathies, aortopathies and coronary artery diseases.

pmc-12690656.title: PDNO-07 SURGICAL MANAGEMENT AND EARLY OUTCOME OF PAEDIATRIC POSTERIOR FOSSA PILOCYTIC ASTROCYTOMAS: A TWO-CENTER EXPERIENCE
pmc-12690656.creator: Ifeanyi Iwuagwu, Aliyu Koko, Ali Lasseini, James Balogun
pmc-12690656.description: IntroductionPosterior fossa pilocytic astrocytomas (PACs) are the commonest paediatric posterior fossa tumours. Delayed presentation, increased morbidity and mortality are common in Sub-Saharan Africa.ObjectiveThis study aims to analyze the clinical presentation and surgical outcomes of children with posterior fossa PACs in two institutions in Nigeria: University College Hospital, Ibadan and Uthman Danfodio Teaching Hospital, Sokoto.

pmc-13213289.title: Protocol for volumetric quantification of intrahepatic triglyceride content in adults with obesity
pmc-13213289.creator: Alba Camacho-Cardenosa, Antonio Clavero-Jimeno, Alejandro López-Vázquez, Mara Concepción, José L Martín-Rodríguez, Idoia Labayen, Jonatan R Ruiz, Rafael Cabeza
pmc-13213289.description: SummaryThe study describes a protocol for the semi-automatic volumetric quantification of intrahepatic triglyceride (IHTG) levels in individuals with obesity based on the Dixon technique. Here, we describe a step-by-step procedure for image acquisition and exportation, followed by segmentation of liver regions and subsequent quantification of IHTG.

pmc-13367128.title: Sensory Tricks in Dystonia: A Systematic Review and Nested Quantitative Synthesis
pmc-13367128.creator: Anish Mehta, Thyagarajan Shivashanmugam, Michiko K. Bruno, Roongroj Bhidayasiri, Sanjay Pandey, Kailash P. Bhatia, Louis C. S. Tan, Pramod Kumar Pal
pmc-13367128.description: BackgroundSensory tricks (also termed “alleviating maneuvers”) are voluntary maneuvers that transiently alleviate dystonic postures or movements and represent a hallmark clinical feature of dystonia with diagnostic and mechanistic significance. Despite extensive phenomenological description, the evidence base has not been systematically synthesized.

pmc-13524325.title: Comparison of non-linear models for growth characterization of purebred Ayrshire and crossbred cattle
pmc-13524325.creator: Mykhailo Matvieiev, Ayhan Ceyhan, Özge Kozaklı, Andriy Getya, Oleksandr O Borshch, Sergiy Ruban
pmc-13524325.description: The objective of this study was to compare four non-linear mathematical models in terms of evaluating the growth pattern of Ayrshire and crossbred (Norwegian Red × Ayrshire) cattle. Monthly live-weight (kg) records of 725 cows were collected from birth to 540 d of age. The growth curves were analyzed using negative exponential, logistic, Richard, and Gompertz models.
